purpose: Post-hoc investigation of all43 mapping-limited events, selected by saved status; no detector changes or signal-based sample exclusion.
reference_orders: Every covering order for each selected event, including old edge-limited orders when the reference aperture exists.
fixed_orientation: Reuse multi-order grid best orientation for the exposure; do not fit orientation or trace shift to candidate cores.
reference_profile: Sample raw image at polynomial-predicted floating column plus offsets -8 through+8 using linear interpolation. Median spatial profile; subtract outer 4 offset baseline, quadratic interpolation of peak. Report correlation of seven-column aperture and native spectrum after31point highpass. No winsorization or amplitude clipping.
mapping_criteria: >=3 usable fixed windows; median correlation>0.8; median absolute peak offset<=0.75 pixels; >=3 windows withabs offset<=1pixel. Header coordinates remain unchanged; no candidate-centered shift.
candidate_display: Preserve original native/raw arrays and wider raw31x33 context around predicted trace; display central±6columns separately so adjacent calibrationfiber cannot dominate.
interpretation: Wider fixed reference support may resolve inadequate old two-sidedwindows, including near edges and crowded candidate lists. Any continued discrepancy remains explicit; geometry does not determine origin.
